description: This file contains internal function declarations and method prototypes for managing ASN.1 base objects within a network service container framework. It defines functions for creating, cloning, encoding, decoding, and manipulating ASN.1 objects, as well as accessor functions for attributes like tags and class names.

methods.name: AnscAsn1Create
methods.description: Factory function to create a new ASN.1 object instance with a given container context.

methods.name: AnscAsn1Free
methods.description: Function to free resources associated with an ASN.1 object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1Clone
methods.description: Create a copy of an ASN.1 object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CopyTo
methods.description: Copy ASN.1 object data from source to destination.

methods.name: AnscAsn1EqualsTo
methods.description: Compare two ASN.1 objects for equality.

methods.name: AnscAsn1SetName
methods.description: Set the name attribute of an ASN.1 object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1SetClassName
methods.description: Set the class name attribute of an ASN.1 object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1IsConstructive
methods.description: Check if ASN.1 object is constructive (constructed type).

methods.name: AnscAsn1GetFirstOctet
methods.description: Retrieve the first octet of the ASN.1 encoded data, often representing the tag.

methods.name: AnscAsn1AddAttribute
methods.description: Add an attribute object to an ASN.1 object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1GetTagValue
methods.description: Retrieve the tag value from ASN.1 attribute data.

methods.name: AnscAsn1ReadyToEncode
methods.description: Check if the ASN.1 object is ready to be encoded.

methods.name: AnscAsn1GetSizeOfEncoded
methods.description: Get size of the ASN.1 encoded data.

methods.name: AnscAsn1DecodingData
methods.description: Decode ASN.1 data from encoded representation.

methods.name: AnscAsn1EncodingData
methods.description: Encode ASN.1 object data into the encoding buffer.

methods.name: AnscAsn1GetEncodedData
methods.description: Retrieve the encoded ASN.1 data and its length.

methods.name: AnscAsn1GetBAOHandle
methods.description: Get the handle associated with the ASN.1 base object.
